#Module webaudio

The Web Audio API's render graph (src/webaudio, src/page/bindings_webaudio.odin), for native/js/odin/web_audio.js: nodes are numbers of a graph, a graph and a buffer are host objects. A graph that a stale object refers to does nothing: these calls come from a realm's finalizers too, in any order.

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/webaudio.widl.

#Types

#callback WebAudioNotify

void WebAudioNotify(i32 user, i32 kind, i32 node, i32 value)

What the render thread has to say: kind 1 the state changed (value: 0 suspended, 1 running, 2 closed), 2 a source ended, 3 a block of a ScriptProcessorNode is ready, 4 an offline rendering stopped at a suspend().
